description: This file contains utility functions for creating mock HTTP request and response objects, mainly for testing purposes within an HTTP server context. It includes functions to generate various types of requests and responses, including stalled requests and form-encoded bodies.

methods.name: export function makeBaseReq( makeBaseReq
methods.description: Creates a basic mock IncomingMessage object with specified HTTP method and options, including headers and URL. It also attaches a destroy method.

methods.name: export function makeReq( makeReq
methods.description: Generates a mock IncomingMessage object with a request body, emitting 'data' and 'end' events asynchronously.

methods.name: export function makeStalledReq( makeStalledReq
methods.description: Creates a base request that does not emit any data, simulating a stalled request.

methods.name: export function makeRes(): ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string } { makeRes
methods.description: Creates a mock ServerResponse object with methods to set status code and body, used for testing HTTP responses.

methods.name: export function makeFormBody(fields: Record<string, string>): string { makeFormBody
methods.description: Converts a key-value object into a URL-encoded form body string.

ctags.name: _body
ctags.pattern: /^  } as unknown as ServerResponse & { _status: number; _body: string };$/

ctags.name: req
ctags.pattern: /^  const req = new EventEmitter() as IncomingMessage & { destroyed: boolean };$/
